title: The "0.4+ amplitude" hard-cut click figure does not reproduce — actual hard-cut wrap jump at the documented window is 0.127 peak
evidence:
0.048 peak amplitude (measured by the build script) — inaudible on an
ambient bed. A hard cut would click (0.4+ amplitude — the track has no
beat-lockable phrase boundary).
detail: README, PR body ("so a hard cut would click (0.4+ amplitude)"), and spec doc all claim 0.4+. Recomputing from the vault WAV with the script's own math: |seg[L-1]-seg[0]| pre-crossfade at [41.4s,167.0s] = 0.1267 peak; max 1-sample jump near the wrap = 0.1267. The 0.048 residual claim reproduces exactly (0.0482); the 0.4+ contrast figure does not.
recommended_fix: Replace "0.4+ amplitude" with the measured ~0.13 one-sample wrap jump (or the actual quantity measured) in README.md, _pr_body_ambience.md, and spec-ambience-bed.md.
